name: 241. Passthrough bodies parsed into the logged conversation (passthrough parsed logs)
description: Passthrough rows (/openai_passthrough, /anthropic_passthrough, /genai_passthrough) used to store only the raw request and response bodies, so the logs UI showed two JSON boxes and the list preview and search were empty. With content logging on, the logging plugin's batch writer now decodes both bodies with the provider's own native-to-Bifrost converters (framework/passthroughparse, routed by provider + path like the passthrough usage extractors) and fills the same fields a typed request does: input_history/output_message for OpenAI chat, responses_input_history/responses_output for Anthropic Messages and Gemini generateContent, plus tools, stop_reason, tool calls and params.parsed_type/model_params. The raw bodies are kept, and parsing is best-effort: a body that does not decode leaves the row raw. Each case calls a passthrough route with a real client's shape, then polls /api/logs/<x-bifrost-request-id> (the row and the parse are written by the async batch writer) and asserts the parsed fields alongside the raw bodies. Red before the change: params.parsed_type never appears, so every case fails on the poll. Content-logging-off behaviour (no parsing, no bodies) is pinned by Go tests in plugins/logging (TestPassthroughLogSkipsParsingWithoutContentLogging), since the harness profile logs content.

item.name: 241.1 openai/gpt-4o-mini /openai_passthrough/v1/chat/completions logs a parsed conversation (passthrough parsed logs)

exec: pm.test('openai chat parsed: upstream call succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('openai chat parsed: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var j = (!err && res.code === 200) ? res.json() : null;
if (j && j.params && j.params.parsed_type !== undefined) {

pm.test('openai chat parsed: stored as chat_completion and tagged passthrough', function () { pm.expect(j.object, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('chat_completion'); pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); });
['chat_completion', 'passthrough'].forEach(function (objectType) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs?objects=' + objectType + '&request_id=' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (ferr, fres) {

pm.test('openai chat parsed: Type filter ' + objectType + ' finds the row', function () { pm.expect(ferr, String(ferr)).to.not.be.ok; pm.expect(fres.code, fres.text()).to.eql(200); var ids = (fres.json().logs || []).map(function (r) { return r.id; }); pm.expect(ids, fres.text()).to.include(reqId); });
pm.test('openai chat parsed: parsed as chat completion', function () { pm.expect(j.params.parsed_type, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql('chat_completion'); });

pm.test('openai chat parsed: input_history parsed from the request body', function () { pm.expect(j.input_history, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.input_history[0].content)).to.include('passthrough parsing'); });

pm.test('openai chat parsed: output_message parsed from the response body', function () { pm.expect(j.output_message, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.output_message.role).to.eql('assistant'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.output_message.content || '')).to.not.eql('""'); });
pm.test('openai chat parsed: model params recorded', function () { pm.expect(j.params.model_params, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('openai chat parsed: stop_reason recorded', function () { pm.expect(j.stop_reason, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('openai chat parsed: raw request body kept', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_request_body, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('openai chat parsed: raw response body kept', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_response_body, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('openai chat parsed: passthrough params intact', function () { pm.expect(j.params.status_code, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql(200); pm.expect(j.params.path, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('openai chat parsed: log row carries parsed passthrough fields', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' has no params.parsed_type after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
checkLog(0);
